dogfoodVentures.currentMilestone: Prove 3 buyer-funded bounties with verified video proofs

capitalNeed.description: Seed initial buyer bounty rewards and mobile video capture verification infrastructure.
capitalNeed.milestone: Reach 15 funded consumer bounties and 1 paying merchant subscription
capitalNeed.targetState: Repeat organic fact requests and positive unit economics on unlock fees.

capitalAnalysis.rationale: Bounties are paid directly by buyers before verification payout. Outside VC at this stage creates unnecessary 15-20% dilution before demand density is proven. Lean customer-funded validation via Mercury is optimal.
capitalAnalysis.alternativeNonDilutive: Regional micro-grant for consumer digital protection (up to €10k) if legal entity is incorporated.

dogfoodVentures.currentMilestone: 10 automated enterprise regression benchmarks and SOC2 certification preflight

capitalNeed.description: Fund enterprise security compliance, multi-model evaluation harness compute, and pilot integrations.
capitalNeed.milestone: 5 enterprise design partners running acceptance gates in CI/CD pipeline
capitalNeed.targetState: Validated €2,500/mo ARR contract value per design partner.

capitalAnalysis.rationale: Enterprise acceptance gates require formal security credentials and reliable cross-provider compute. A €150k Post-Money SAFE paired with a Eurostars R&D grant provides 12 months runway without aggressive VC board loss.
capitalAnalysis.alternativeNonDilutive: Eurostars-3 Innovation Call (€250k grant with 50% co-funding).

dogfoodVentures.currentMilestone: 20 event organizer partnerships and 50 standby vendor registrations

capitalNeed.description: WhatsApp broadcast API setup, localized landing page, and organizer pilot materials.
capitalNeed.milestone: Fill 10 last-minute cancelled vendor slots and collect €250 in success fees
capitalNeed.targetState: Self-sustaining two-sided standby directory with positive word-of-mouth.
